1.web: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
1.asv: Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.

2.web: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
2.asv: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.

3.web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
3.asv: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.

4.web: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
4.asv: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?

5.web: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
5.asv: All the day long they wrest my words: All their thoughts are against me for evil.

6.web: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.
6.asv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.

7.web: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
7.asv: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

8.web: You number my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
8.asv: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?

9.web: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.
9.asv: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.

10.web: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
10.asv: In God (I will praise his word), In Jehovah (I will praise his word),

11.web: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
11.asv: In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?

12.web: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
12.asv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thank-offerings unto thee.

13.web: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
13.asv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: Hast thou not delivered my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living?
